sourceQuote: After graduation, students will be able to work as radio or television editors, correspondents, cameramen, TV hosts, and professional TV and Radio producers and planners in broadcast & TV units, media and publicity & culture departments.
targetQuote: 毕业后，学生可在广播电视台、媒体、宣传和文化部门从事广播电视编辑、记者、摄像师、电视主持人以及专业制片人和策划工作。
